document.about: Eppendorf Multipette E3/E3x performance data sheet. Page 1 notes a feature under its features list in a 5pt footnote, `1) Feature only available with Multipette E3x`, under 7pt text.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#192): a numbered line set below the body's size was read as a level-1 numbered heading, and the rest of the document nested under the footnote.
2026-11-25 (#281): the sheet numbers its notes `1)`, raised after the word they mark (`dilution series¹⁾`). A note mark had to be figures alone, so the `1)` was glued to its word.

checks.issue: `1) Feature only available with Multipette E3x` opened a level-1 section holding the rest of the document.
